title: Analytics Engine
description:
Spring Data Analysis API is a Spring Boot–based data analysis REST service where user can ingest CSV files and recieve data analytics such as column types, null counts, and statistical summaries. It also allows download the analysis. The API is designed for real-world data engineering workflows including dataset exploration, data quality assessment, and ETL validation.

Key capabilities

  • CSV ingestion and automatic data profiling
  • Column type detection and null count analysis
  • Statistical summaries for numeric fields
  • Persistent storage of analysis results
  • REST endpoints for upload, download, and deletion
  • Swagger UI for interactive API testing
techStack: Tech Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Gradle, JUnit 5, Mockito, AWS

title: “Find A Placement” - Group Project, University of Salford Hack Camp. Web Application for BCS Manchester
description:
BCS Student Placement Portal is a demo web-based placement matching system developed for BCS Manchester to increase undergraduate placement uptake by matching university students with employers offering year-long industrial placements. The system supports students, employers, university career staff, and administrators, with matching logic aligned to SFIA Version 8.

Key capabilities

  • Role-based user accounts for students, employers, career staff, and administrators
  • Session-based authentication and access control
  • Student profile management with CV upload (PDF)
  • SFIA v8 skill and level management
  • Placement creation, management, and shortlisting
  • Skill-based placement matching and notifications
  • Career staff dashboards for monitoring outcomes
  • Responsive UI with role-specific dashboards
techStack: Tech Stack: PHP, SQLite, Bootstrap 5, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, SFIA v8
